status: DRAFT - entries are existing, documented project rules, copied from CLAUDE.md and the workflow headers. Nothing here is a new decision.

decisions.question: Should auto-merge also require an approval or an auto-merge label?
decisions.decision: No. Mark a pull request as a draft to opt out.

decisions.question: May the bot change the release of a listed Archicad version in devkits.json?
decisions.decision: No. Versions are only appended, by archicad_devkit_update.yml.

decisions.question: Does the legacy auto-update script move, get renamed or lose options?
decisions.decision: No. Released add-ons download it from main with fixed options.

decisions.question: Does a Grasshopper tool component delete elements?
decisions.decision: No. Delete stays in the separate DeleteElements component.
